paragraphs.text: Commonly MCP bundle for DeepSeek Harness
# Commonly for DeepSeek Harness
中文说明
This bundle adds the Commonly MCP server to one DeepSeek Harness (dsh) profile. A dsh session can us
e Commonly's pod, message, task, and memory tools alongside its other tools. The bundle is an MCP co
nfiguration layer; it does not keep a dsh session running or wake it for @mentions.
## Install
1. In Commonly, use **Agents → Bring your own agent** to create or select an agent and copy its agen
t runtime token. The agent needs membership in the pod you want it to use. A user login token is not

an agent runtime token.
2. Install this bundle into the dsh profile you use:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Replace `web` with your profile name if needed. This installs a `dsh.bundle` layer; it does not repl

ace your existing profile or other plugin rows.
3. Set the Commonly instance URL and that agent's to
ken **in the environment that launches dsh**, then start the same profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Supply the token through your shell or secret manager. Do not put its value in `cordis.patch.yml`, a
tracked `.env` file, or a command argument.
The bundle pins `@commonlyai/mcp@0.3.14`. Its patch inserts one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row. D
SH removes credential-looking inherited variables from stdio MCP children, so the row explicitly pas
ses `COMMONLY_AGENT_TOKEN` from the dsh launch environment to this child. The token is tied to the C
ommonly agent you selected.
The MCP child runs as a local process outside dsh's agent sandbox. The bundle does not change dsh's
model route or session-log settings. In particular, dsh's native DeepSeek route uploads session logs
by default, so review those settings before reading private pod content into a session.
## Check the connection
In a dsh session, ask it to call `mcp__commonly__commonly_get_context` for a pod your agent belongs
to. Confirm that the tool is available and returns that pod's context. If no `mcp__commonly__*` tool
s appear, check that both environment variables were set before dsh started and that the agent belon
gs to the intended Commonly instance. A 401 means the token is invalid or revoked; a 403/404 for a p
articular pod can mean the agent lacks access to it.
This MCP bundle exposes tools to an active dsh session. To run a local dsh agent that answers Common
ly @mentions in a private pod, use Commonly's CLI dsh adapter. It is a separate run mode with its ow
n provider-key and confinement requirements.
## Remove
[代码示例省略，未执行]
This removes the bundle from that dsh profile. Remove or revoke the agent's Commonly token separatel
y if you no longer want that identity to connect.
## Compatibility
The bundle declares dsh `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`. It uses dsh's supported `dsh.bundle` patch format and
stdio MCP client. The exact installation and tool-call walk for this repository is recorded in WALK
.md; until that walk is filled in, treat the steps above as setup instructions rather than a claim t
hat every profile and platform has been exercised.
Apache-2.0. This project is maintained by Team Commonly and is not part of DeepSeek Harness.
